author: Marcus R. Brown
description:
Brings sparkle to agent-native parity with marcusrbrown/marcusrbrown and mrbro.dev. After 6 months of pure Renovate-only automation, this wires the unified Fro Bot template into sparkle.

## What

### `.github/workflows/fro-bot.yaml` (new, 740 lines)

Unified workflow — one file handles three modes:

| Mode | Triggers | Cadence |
|---|---|---|
| **Review** | PR open/sync/reopen/ready_for_review/review_requested, `@fro-bot` mention in comments | On-event |
| **Maintenance** | `schedule`, `workflow_dispatch` | 17:00 UTC daily |
| **Autoheal** | `schedule`, `workflow_dispatch` | 05:00 UTC daily |

Schedule slots staggered off siblings: marcusrbrown (04:30/16:30), mrbro.dev (03:30/15:30).

**Guards copied from upstream template:**
- Bot author + fork PR skip at the job-level `if:`
- `OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR` author-association required for comment triggers
- Fork-PR-head refusal on `issue_comment`-triggered checkouts (the comment payload lacks the fork flag the job-level guard relies on)
- Concurrency keyed on issue/PR/discussion number with `cancel-in-progress: false`
- Sunday UTC detection feeds `IS_SUNDAY_UTC` for category 8 cadence
